parts.text: Calcular estadísticas descriptivas (mínimo, percentil 25, mediana, percentil 75, máximo y media) del recuento de ocurrencias individuales por cada episodio de condición (condition era). Genera directamente la consulta SQL SELECT para BigQuery.

Here is the SQL query to calculate the descriptive statistics for the `condition_occurrence_count` within the `condition_era` table.

This query calculates the minimum, 25th percentile, median (50th percentile), 75th percentile, maximum, and mean of the number of individual condition occurrences aggregated into each condition era.

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    MIN(t.condition_occurrence_count) AS min_occurrences,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(t.condition_occurrence_count, 100)[OFFSET(25)] AS percentile_25,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(t.condition_occurrence_count, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_occurrences,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(t.condition_occurrence_count, 100)[OFFSET(75)] AS percentile_75,
    MAX(t.condition_occurrence_count) AS max_occurrences,
    AVG(CAST(t.condition_occurrence_count AS BIGNUMERIC)) AS mean_occurrences
FROM
    `condition_era` AS t
